create_reducer_subclass: create a python subclass of Reducer that implements reduce, save_state, and load_state methods
implement_reduce_method: implement the reduce method in a Reducer subclass to aggregate results from a runner
implement_save_state: implement the save_state method in a Reducer subclass to checkpoint reducer state to disk
implement_load_state: implement the load_state method in a Reducer subclass to restore reducer state from a checkpoint
use_mock_reducer: use MockReducer to test reducer integration with a runner config without real reduction logic
